plugin.split.art_need_img: Import an artwork image first: without an image, keying has no object.
plugin.split.art_note: Imported image (PNG/JPEG), not a 6th video input: live video artwork would cost 21.7 ms/frame at 1080p (108 % of the 50 fps budget). A transparent PNG with the “alpha” key is the cleanest case. The image is not persisted: re-import it after a container redeploy.
plugin.split.art_pending: Image imported — enable the artwork to bake it.
plugin.split.art_w_covers: The artwork is opaque over NEARLY THE WHOLE frame and sits ABOVE: it completely covers the boxes (they are composed, then painted over). Uncheck “Above the boxes”, change the key, or lower the opacity.
plugin.split.art_w_noalpha: This image has NO transparency channel (JPEG, or opaque PNG). With the “alpha” key it is therefore fully opaque and WILL HIDE the boxes. Fixes: import a PNG with a transparent background, pick the “luma” or “chroma” key, or place the artwork BELOW the boxes.
plugin.split.bg_w_clip: Colour OUTSIDE the legal (broadcast) range: it was clipped to the encodable range. Uncheck “Legal range” to encode it full-range (at the risk of clipping downstream).
plugin.split.bg_w_nosrc: Background is set to “video source” but no source is wired: the background will be BLACK. Pick a source above, or switch the background to black/colour.
plugin.split.border_arm_hint: Disabled, the widths are kept but no longer shown: re-enabling restores them as they were.
plugin.split.border_disarmed: Border disabled: these values are kept but not applied. Enable the border to adjust them.
plugin.split.border_note: Bevel relief comes from the light source (global, below): without it, a bevel is just a gradient.
plugin.split.box_enable_one: Show this box (per-box setting, never applied to the selection).
plugin.split.box_src_one: Source of this box (per-box setting, never applied to the selection).
plugin.split.budget_na: Engine metrics unavailable (:8080) — is the container running?
plugin.split.budget_ok_t: Per-frame compositing cost against the frame-rate budget (100 % = drop-out).
plugin.split.budget_over_t: Compositing exceeds the frame budget: the Split drops below its target fps. Rotation is by far the heaviest item — removing it is the first move.
plugin.split.budget_warn_t: Compositing is approaching the frame budget — no headroom left for another effect.
plugin.split.crop_arm_hint: Disabled, the four values are kept but no longer crop: re-enabling restores them as they were.
plugin.split.crop_disarmed: Crop disabled: these values are kept but not applied. Enable Crop to adjust them.
plugin.split.free_only: Only active with “Free” aspect: with the aspect kept, the box keeps its source format and a single size is enough.
plugin.split.g_hint: Double-click a dial = default value (the Global returns to neutral, setting by setting). It is stored in memories and interpolated during transitions. Measured cost: none — it folds into each box's stamp. While it is not neutral, canvas snapping is disabled (snapping in a rotated frame would draw lying guides).
plugin.split.global_scope: The Global transforms the GROUP: it composes on top of each box's settings (render = Global ∘ box) without overwriting any of them — boxes keep their relative positions. That is what lets the whole group enter or leave the frame. A box's EDGE attributes (crop, feather, corners, border, bevel, shadow, mirror, aspect) and what belongs to a single box (source, enable, z-order) therefore do not apply to it: they are not shown here.
plugin.split.global_tip: GLOBAL channel: a transform layer applied ON TOP of each box's own settings (group offset, scale, rotation, opacity). It does not replace the boxes' values — it composes with them. This is what makes whole-group entries and exits from frame possible.
plugin.split.grad_anim_note: The gradient is stored in memories and interpolated during transitions: two memories (one at position 0, one at position 1) recalled with a duration give an ANIMATED WIPE sweeping the screen — with no new mechanism. Static it costs nothing (cached render); animated full-frame it holds 1080p50 for 2 stops and is at budget for 3-4 (see help).
plugin.split.grad_soft_note: Softness 0 = SHARP boundary (wipe); 1 = smooth gradient. A wipe is just a gradient of zero softness.
plugin.split.hint: Click a box to select it · <kbd>Shift</kbd>+click = multi-select (dragging moves the WHOLE selection) · bottom-right corner = size · edges = crop · <kbd>←↑→↓</kbd> = 1 px (bypasses snapping), <kbd>Shift</kbd> = 10 px. The FRAME EDGE snaps: the box sticks to it from the inside (fully visible) or just beyond it (fully out — the natural start/end of an on-screen entry).
plugin.split.knob_title: Vertical drag, mouse wheel, arrow keys (Shift = fine step). Double-click = default value.
plugin.split.look_note: The light gives bevelled borders their relief — a single light lits the whole scene (four inconsistent lights = a fake set). The stagger makes boxes arrive one after another; it is counted WITHIN the requested duration.
plugin.split.mem_note: Recall uses the curve and stagger set in “Light & transitions”.
plugin.split.mixed_color: Different colours in the selection: picking one uniformises them.
plugin.split.mixed_knob: Multiple values in the selection. Acting on this control applies it to ALL selected boxes (uniformise).
plugin.split.mixed_toggle: Different states in the selection: toggling applies the same state to ALL selected boxes.
plugin.split.multi_delta: Multi-selection: the value you type is applied as an OFFSET (the change requested on the reference box is carried over to each box, which keeps its own layout).
plugin.split.multi_note: Any setting changed below applies to ALL selected boxes. Position, size and z-order are carried over as an OFFSET (each box keeps its relative layout); appearance (crop, rotation, opacity, border, shadow…) is UNIFORMISED. A “≠” marks diverging values: as long as you don't touch that control, it is not overwritten. Source and activation stay per-box (“Boxes & background” column).
plugin.split.out_clipped: Hatched area = outside the frame: cropped on air
plugin.split.reset_box: Reset the window: full frame, centred, no crop. Clears neither the source, nor the border, nor the shadow, nor the effects.
plugin.split.reset_done: Window reset: full frame, centred, no crop.
plugin.split.reset_done_n: Windows reset: full frame, centred, no crop.
plugin.split.rot_anim: ANIMATED rotation (a transition, or dragging the dial) is over budget in this format: the 2D maps are rebuilt every frame (~53 ms at 1080p). At REST, rotation costs almost nothing (C kernel).
plugin.split.rot_live_over: The engine is currently over the frame budget and
plugin.split.rot_live_over2: box(es) are rotated: set rotation back to 0 to recover the frame rate.
plugin.split.shadow_off: Enable the drop shadow (switch above) to edit these values.
plugin.split.snap_title: Snaps the box to the frame edges and center, and to the other boxes. The arrow keys bypass snapping (pixel-accurate placement).
plugin.split.stale_engine: The engine deployed on this container does not publish its transition settings (script older than the 0.9.0 contract): the values above are the manifest defaults, not the live state. Redeploy the container to remove the ambiguity.
type.split.cfg.cadence.help: flow: sliced fabric — each layer targets the epoch index of its source and the output is written at that same index (requires slice mode to be eligible, otherwise falls back to historical pacing).
type.split.cfg.cadence.label: Composition pacing
type.split.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.split.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.split.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.split.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.split.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour. The background and each box follow their own source grain.
type.split.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.split.label: Split
